The property is ideally located within 15 minutes drive from Da Nang International airport, 4 kilometers to the city center and 4 kilometers to Han Market. The hotel provides a variety of well-appointed rooms and suites suitable for single travelers, couples, triples and families. Each room is thoughtfully designed to ensure your utmost comfort and convenience throughout your stay. Featuring amenities such as a flat-screen TV, a cozy seating area, and a kettle in every room, we aim to provide you with all the essential elements for a pleasant and enjoyable experience. Guests can approach the 24-hour front desk for currency exchange, tour arrangements and concierge services. A fitness center is available for working out. Alternatively, guests can indulge in a variety of spa treatments from Cicilia Spa. The in-house restaurants serve up an array of Asian and continental delights. Children Policy: According to hotel policy and restrictedly set up in Booking.com website, 2 children under 12 years old are allowed to stay with their parents, in detail: - The 1st child 0-4 years old stays for free if using the existing bed. - Children 5-11 years old will be charged VND 200.000 per child per night if using the existing bed. - Children from 12 years old and above require an extra bed with additional cost at 400,000 VND per child per night (only some rooms can place extra beds, kindly check the room description and capacity). Please double check your reservation. In case you have not provided us with the number and age of children when you make this reservation, please pay the children surcharge at the hotel. Important Notice: From March 19 to March 30, 2025, the 19th-floor swimming pool at Cicilia Danang Hotel & Spa will be closed for maintenance. We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience and appreciate your understanding. Thank you.
